title: Student Study Habits and Online Learning
description: A short survey on how students study and learn online. Takes about 5 minutes.

questions.text: I find it easy to focus during online classes.
I keep a regular study schedule.
I have a quiet place to study at home.
My internet connection is reliable enough for school work.
I feel confident about my grades this semester.
How many hours do you study outside class on a typical school day?
What is the biggest challenge you face when studying online?
Describe one study method that works well for you and why.
